recipes.title: April Sustainable Profile — Modbar Espresso
recipes.description: April Coffee Roasters' base espresso recipe for their House line: 18 g in for 48 g out at 6 bar, ground on a Mahlkönig E80.
recipes.notes: April publish this as a base recipe on a Modbar at 6 bar. Shot time is stated as 23–25 seconds and target TDS as 6.5–8, both windows rather than points. The grind setting is written on April's own E80 dial, with a comma as the decimal separator. The same page's Selection espresso block states this line's yield as 48–50 g; the House section's own block, transcribed here, states 48 g.
